personajes.CONTROL: Flight Director Ana Ortega, Mission Control (Houston)
personajes.TÚ: Commander of the Selene-7, an Artemis-era mission (fiction)

intro.texto: Selene-7 mission log, 2026. Our goal was a short survey of the south pole, where LCROSS found water ice in 2009.
Commander… can you hear me? This is ARIA. The impact broke the antenna and emptied the tanks.
We're at the Moon's south pole. Earth's last transmission came in before the crash: since then, silence.

Worse: a coronal mass ejection (CME) hit right after we landed and fried our orbital relay. Until we build a new one, we survive the way NASA plans to — with ISRU, like MOXIE on Mars and PRIME-1 here: making air, water and fuel from what the Moon gives us.
Three historic sites are near: LCROSS debris in the dark crater, a VIPER rover test unit and a Surveyor/Apollo 12 beacon. Find them on the map — they hold supplies and history.

Keep your space suit on outside: without it the vacuum kills you in seconds. It wears out and you can't drink with the helmet on, so inside the habitat take it off (V or the SUIT button) to drink, then put it back on.
First things first: there's a leak. Seal it before we lose our air.

principales.objetivo: Seal a leak (hold E with 1 Sealant kit — craft: 2 Scrap + 1 Metal)

fin.texto: Leak contained. The habitat is holding… for now. We need water: there's ice in the shadowed crater.
In 1970 Apollo 13 lost an oxygen tank too. Lovell, Swigert and Haise improvised and came home. So will we. (New entries in the Archive 📚)

principales.objetivo: Collect 6 ice in the shadowed crater

fin.texto: Excellent. Take it to the habitat (E) to melt it. With electricity we'll split it into hydrogen and oxygen: our fuel.
Lunar Prospector (1998) and LCROSS (2009) showed there's water ice in these cold craters. You just held some.
First kilos of LH2! The leftover oxygen goes to the habitat: we breathe what we burn.
The rocket is badly damaged. Start with the Structure and the Power.
Making fuel from local resources is called ISRU: in-situ resource utilization. Real lunar programs plan to do exactly this.

principales.objetivo: Repair the rocket's Structure and Power to 70%

fin.texto: The ship is breathing again. But with no antenna we don't know when a return window opens.
Idea: a CubeSat in orbit can relay our signal to Earth. Design it from the rocket.
Landers like Beresheet (2019) and Vikram (2019) were lost when one system failed during descent. That's why we repair every subsystem.

principales.objetivo: Design and launch the CubeSat relay

fin.texto: …Selene-7, this is Mission Control. Commander? We thought we'd lost you!
We're sending you the return windows. Fill the tanks, repair the ship and don't miss your date.
Chang'e 4 (2019) used the Queqiao relay satellite to talk to Earth from the far side. Our CubeSat does the same.

principales.objetivo: Subsystems at 90% and tanks with the next window's fuel

fin.texto: All set. When the window opens, start the countdown from the rocket.
Chandrayaan-3 reached this south polar region in 2023. Luna 25 crashed the same year after a bad maneuver. Our window must be exact.
Liftoff confirmed, Selene-7. Welcome home, commander.
The last Apollo crew left the Moon in 1972. You're part of a new generation of lunar explorers. Welcome home.

secundarias.fin: ARIA: There was a thermal suit in the cargo. Equip it from the inventory.

secundarias.objetivo: Survive a solar flare without radiation sickness
secundarias.fin: ARIA: Well done. Regolith and the habitat walls stop the particles.
ARIA: The nights will feel shorter. Careful: light drains the battery.
ARIA: Maintenance up to date. That's how you survive up here.
ARIA: I don't know what those things are, but now they fear us a little.

secundarias.objetivo: Get the perfect 6:1 mix in the tanks
secundarias.fin: ARIA: Ideal mix. I found a spare engine part in storage.

secundarias.objetivo: Craft the Reflective cape, equip it and enter the Scorch Fields
secundarias.fin: ARIA: Scorch Fields reached. The titanium ore there is what we need for the bridge.

secundarias.objetivo: With the Thermal suit, collect 5 Frost crystals in the Frozen Basin
secundarias.fin: ARIA: Those crystals keep things cold for much longer. Perfect for cryotank upgrades.

secundarias.objetivo: Build the bridge to the Alien Hive (10 Metal, 6 Regolith, 2 Titanium)
secundarias.fin: ARIA: The bridge holds. Careful: something lives over there, in every mode.

secundarias.objetivo: Collect 3 Alien alloy in the Alien Hive
secundarias.fin: ARIA: This alloy is unlike anything on Earth. Our best upgrades need it.

final: The Selene-7 leaves the lunar south pole behind.
The fuel you made from crater ice carries you home.
Thanks to your CubeSat, Earth never stopped hearing you: you were its last contact, and you came back.
